findings.summary: crates/server/src/board.rs:rollouts_for links each in-flight rollout in a repo to every ticket of that repo in Stage Rollout, or in PR review with its PR merged. A ticket left in Rollout after its own canary finished will show the next, unrelated canary. That goes against AC-4's 'a ticket with no rollout in progress shows none'. This is documented (latest-tagged images) in docs/STATUS.md and the code comment, so it is not blocking, but the owner should know.

deploy/templates/rbac.yaml and _helpers.tpl were not rendered (no helm in this container). Only reading them: one RoleBinding per distinct rolloutNamespace to a get/list-only ClusterRole on argoproj.io rollouts, and the pod sets automountServiceAccountToken: true, which overrides the ServiceAccount's false. Nothing was checked on the real cluster.

evidence: AC-4 test crates/server/tests/rollouts.rs:only_a_rollout_in_flight_shows_on_its_tickets_card: PASS. In a scratch worktree with the stableRS==currentPodHash completeness check disabled in cluster.rs it FAILS: the TRU-6 card also gets the healthy 'identity' rollout. The test can fail. The full workspace tests, cargo fmt --check and clippy -D warnings all pass.

AC-4 e2e GET /v1/snapshot from board-server with KUBE_ENDPOINT serving tests/fixtures/rollouts.json and a stub Linear (booking: TRU-6 Rollout, TRU-7 Build; sdlc-board: TRU-10 Rollout): TRU-6 rollouts = [web: step 2 of 5, weight 20, Paused, analysis Running]. TRU-7 and TRU-10 have none. The healthy identity rollout is absent. The cluster source has last_good set and no error.

AC-4 browser web build (crates/app/web/build.sh) served by BOARD_WEB_DIR, Playwright chromium with the page kept open while the stand-in Rollout changed: The TRU-6 card read 'web: step 2 of 5 at 20%, Paused, analysis Running'. After the stand-in moved to currentStepIndex 3 at weight 50, the open page updated to 'web: step 4 of 5 at 50%, Paused, analysis Running'. After the rollout completed (stableRS = currentPodHash), the line disappeared from the card. The TRU-7 and TRU-10 cards never showed a rollout. The console had no errors.

AC-4 e2e cases the tests don't cover: a Rollout with no status, a blueGreen Rollout, an aborted canary with a Failed analysis, then the namespace returning 404: No status and blueGreen were skipped without error. The aborted canary showed as 'sched' step 1 of 2, weight 0, phase Aborted, analysis Failed. On the 404 the cluster source kept its last rollouts on the card and reported last_error 'no namespace's rollouts could be read ... 404'. Linear and GitHub were unaffected.
